subject: Post-call recap: MedFlow discovery + request for buying-process exception
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aneeta Shah <aneeta@medflow.co>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medflow.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: MedFlow discovery + next steps

Hi Aneeta / Sanjay — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Call summary (30m):
- Use case: MedFlow wants to augment clinician notes with on-call triage summaries and short patient-facing explainers. Primary constraint is predictable latency (sub-300ms p50 on short summary flows) and strict PHI handling.
- Expected pilot: 3 teams, ~8 clinicians producing ~1.2M tokens/month during pilot. If successful, potential rollup across 5 clinics.
- Primary decision criteria: latency, cost/unit, auditability (audit logs + KV cache retention policy), and contractual data residency.

Stakeholder map (from the call):
- Aneeta Shah — Project lead / clinical program owner (economic buyer influence).
- Sanjay Rao — VP of Engineering (infrastructure / SRE + technical sign-off).
- Procurement (procurement@medflow.co) — legal/PO terms and billing.
- Security: internal security contact TBD (Aneeta will introduce).

Agreed next steps:
1) Aneeta to share procurement timeline and security contact (by EOD Tue).
2) Dev: provide a short security evidence pack + standard SOC2 artifact list and a pilot pricing outline (by Thu).
3) If procurement needs SLA or liability exceptions for pilot, we'll escalate internally at Redwood and request an exception approval.

Attachments in follow-up: we will upload the security evidence pack and a one-page pilot SOW.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the artifacts and a proposed commercial for the 8-week pilot.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Healthcare
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Pilot_Pricing_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Aneeta Shah <aneeta@medflow.co>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medflow.co>, MedFlow Procurement <procurement@medflow.co>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: MedFlow discovery + next steps

Thanks Dev — great summary. A couple of clarifications: 
- Security contact: looping in our InfoSec lead, Priya Menon (pri.menon@medflow.co) — she'll own the questionnaire.
- Procurement timeline: procurement team is aiming for an internal review week of Aug 2 and a PO by Aug 9 if legal and security sign off. Attached is a high-level procurement timeline and our standard vendor PO template.

Notes:
- Economic buyer is primarily our Chief Medical Officer but Aneeta will run the final recommendation to them at the end of the pilot.
- We will likely ask for a written SLA of 99.5% availability for inference endpoints during pilot window; procurement may push for a lower cap on liability for vendors.

Attaching: MedFlow_Procurement_Timeline.pdf and our standard Vendor_PO_Template.pdf (see placeholders).

Appreciate the security packet you mentioned. Once Priya reviews the questionnaire she'll share additional asks.

— Aneeta
Aneeta Shah
Program Lead, Clinical AI
MedFlow Health
[Attachment: MedFlow_Procurement_Timeline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Request: approval to offer pilot concession + SLA variance for MedFlow (DEAL-12877)

Team — following the discovery call and the procurement timeline Aneeta sent, procurement is asking for a few items that will require internal sign-off: 

Ask summary (pilot only):
1) Commercial concession: 25% discount on list pilot pricing (8-week pilot) to make the unit economics favorable and accelerate adoption across their clinics.
2) SLA variance: Commit to 99.5% availability for inference endpoints during the pilot window and allow a single rolling 72-hour maintenance window for platform updates. Procurement is concerned about higher SLAs and is pressing for a lower liability cap.
3) Limited data residency language: customer wants confirmation that pilot data will be processed in the us-east-1 region and retention TTL can be set to 30 days for caching.

Rationale:
- Pilot pipeline is small but highly strategic — if successful they will consolidate more clinics and the ARR upside is significant (estimated TCV $1.2M over 24 months).
- Procurement's aggressive PO timeline (internal review week of Aug 2). We need to tell them yes/no quickly so they can move to legal.

Risks / controls: 
- Discount reduces short-term revenue but is recoverable if we convert to committed capacity (Dedicated) with normal pricing.
- SLA variance is acceptable for a pilot but needs a capped indemnity and a defined maintenance window.
- Security: Aneeta has looped Priya Menon — attaching the security spreadsheet I prepared.

Attachments: MedFlow_Security_Requirements.xlsx, Draft_PO_MedFlow_REDWOOD.docx

Request: Marissa / Jonas / Neha — can I get approval to offer the 25% pilot discount and approve the SLA variance subject to a legal indemnity cap and data residency language? If yes, I'll send a redline of the PO and ask Legal to prepare the conditional approval language.

Thanks — Dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approval to offer pilot concession + SLA variance for MedFlow (DEAL-12877)

Dev — thanks for the clear ask and rationale. I support escalating this to Legal for conditional approval with the following negotiation guardrails: 

Commercial:
- Approve the 25% pilot discount for the 8-week pilot, contingent on: (a) a signed PO within 30 days and (b) an agreement to run an expedite evaluation session with CS at pilot start.

SLA / Liability:
- Agree to the 99.5% pilot SLA but require Legal to insert a limited liability cap equal to 3x pilot fees and an explicit exclusion for scheduled maintenance (72-hour max rolling window).

Security / Data residency:
- Confirm processing in us-east-1 and a 30-day TTL for cached content; require customer to sign a data processing addendum (DPA) covering PHI handling during pilot.

Ask to Legal / Compliance (Neha): please prepare: (1) PO redline with the SLA variance language, (2) limited liability cap clause, and (3) DPA addendum template.

If Legal gives conditional sign-off, I approve moving forward and instruct Dev to share the redlined PO with MedFlow and request DocuSign.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approval to offer pilot concession + SLA variance for MedFlow (DEAL-12877) — Legal conditional approval

Team — reviewed the facts and attachments. Legal / Compliance can provide conditional approval with the following requirements: 

1) Discount: OK for the 25% pilot concession; must be limited to the 8-week pilot term and documented in the PO. We will not retroactively extend discount without an approved amendment.

2) SLA variance: We will permit a 99.5% pilot SLA with the requested 72-hour rolling maintenance window under these conditions: 
   - A limited liability cap equal to 3x the fees for the pilot period only.
   - Explicit carve-outs for acts of God / customer misconfiguration.
   - A requirement that MedFlow sign a change-control for any SLA change after pilot.

3) Data residency & PHI: Require a signed DPA that specifies processing in us-east-1, a max 30-day cache TTL, and that Redwood will not persist PHI beyond the TTL. For pilot, we will keep audit logs for 90 days (can negotiate longer for enterprise).

4) Procurement redlines: I have prepared a PO redline and the DPA addendum. Links below to review and share with the customer: 
   - DocuSign PO (draft): https://www.docusign.com/en/12345-MedFlow-PO
   - Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bMedFlowSalesFolder

If Marissa confirms, Dev please send the redlined PO to procurement@medflow.co and request DocuSign execution with the deadline of Aug 9 to align with their calendar. I'll join any legal sync if MedFlow asks.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Draft_PO_MedFlow_REDWOOD.docx (docx)]
